business_problem: Yet, Children’s National struggled with a fractured data architecture that created barriers to basic reporting, timely insights and advanced research. “Historically, Children’s National had fractured data architectures and challenges with getting basic insights and analytics promptly,” says Mike McLaughlin, Head of AI/ML and Advanced Analytics at Children’s National.
solution_summary: Children’s National Hospital, based in Washington, D.C., was established in 1870 to help every child grow up stronger. Today, it is one of the top 10 children’s hospitals in the nation and ranked in all specialties evaluated by U.S. News & World Report. Children’s National is transforming care on Databricks. By utilizing the Databricks Data + AI Platform, Children’s National reduced model training time from months to minutes, deployed GenAI agentic tools like Spotlight AI to streamline clinical workflows and hospital accreditation, sped up nurse onboarding and scaled predictive analytics for critical care. As a leader in research and innovation, Children’s National is building domain-specific GenAI applications on Databricks — securely, cost-effectively and at scale — to deliver faster insights and better outcomes for children with complex healthcare needs.
